title: ENTRA PIM EXPLAINED: Securing Privileged Access with Mark Orr [MVP]
description:
Attackers rarely break in anymore, they sign in, and over-privileged admin accounts make that easy. In this episode Microsoft MVP Mark Orr shows Microsoft 365 and security admins how Entra Privileged Identity Management, phishing-resistant MFA, Intune device compliance and Conditional Access work together, and how PowerShell automation makes just-in-time access practical.
In this episode
00:00 – From Marine Corps satcom to Microsoft cloud07:41 – Why identity is the new perimeter13:13 – Common mistakes with privileged accounts and Zero Trust18:05 – How Intune and Entra ID complement each other21:19 – Entra PIM and just-in-time access28:29 – Approvals, auditing, compliance and licensing38:15 – PowerShell, automation and learning with AI49:08 – Community tools and rapid-fire round
Key takeaways
Protect the identity plane first: move to passwordless, phishing-resistant authentication before investing in advanced device compliance or AI.Entra PIM replaces standing admin rights with just-in-time, task-driven elevation, ideally with justifications, approvals and authentication context that forces MFA on every activation.Combining Intune device compliance, device filtering and Conditional Access with cloud-only admin accounts creates defense in depth, and PowerShell keeps admins working when portals fail.
Worth quoting
“just in time elevation should be task driven and when the task is complete deactivate your role because you're opening yourself up to risk not only to yourself but to the organization” – Mark Orr (25:40)
“I feel like zero trust is a is a moving target and I see so many organizations get paralyzed trying to be perfect” – Mark Orr (17:19)
Explore more on M365.FM
Episode page: the full episode with chapters, quotes and FAQMark Orr – the Marine Corps veteran and MVP who built a PowerShell module for bulk PIM activationConditional Access – the policy layer that ties device compliance, device filtering and authentication context to PIM elevationZero Trust – a moving target that Mark Orr says should not paralyze organizations chasing perfectionRelated episode: Global Secure Access - Simply Explained
